8.description: Added over 300 Quest PoI locations to outland daily quests. More will be coming soon!

2.description: Fixed an issue with Telredor elevator and phasing. Players will no longer see a duplicate elevator or fall through one they are standing on.

4.description: [Area 52] Added Customizable Icons and Naming for Specializations.

1.description: Fixed an issue where the Barrage talent wasn't properly increasing the healing reduction effect of Aimed Shot.

5.description: Increased the drop chance of small pouches by 33%.

2.description: Increased the respawn rate of Battered, Tattered, and Solid Chests by 20%.

0.description: Reduced the effectiveness of heals and absorbs in arenas by 10%.

1.description: Fixed a bug where the scaling of Mana Shield and Power Word: Shield was incorrect. This bugfix will result in a slight reduction in the amount absorbed.
Titan's Grip now reduces all damage done to players by 8% but no longer reduces   the damage of Bladestorm by 10%.
Shadow Bolt now deals 5% reduced damage against players. It previously did not get reduced.
Arcane Barrage now deals 15% reduced damage against players, from 10%.
Stormstrike now deals 15% reduced damage against players, from 10%.
Overpower now deals 20% reduced damage against players, from 15%.
Insect Swarm now deals 15% reduced damage against players, from 20%.
Flame Shock now deals 20% reduced damage against players, from 25%.
Conflagrate now deals 20% reduced damage against players, from 25%.
Ignite no longer deals reduced damage against players. It previously had its damage reduced by 10%.
Pyroblast now deals 10% reduced damage against players, from 15%.
Devouring Plague now deals 25% reduced damage against players, from 35%.
Serpent Sting now deals 15% reduced damage against players, from 20%.
Rake now deals 25% reduced damage against players, from 30%.
Shadow Word: Pain now deals 25% reduced damage against players, from 30%.
Holy Fire now deals 15% reduced damage against players, from 20%.
Chain Lightning now deals 15% reduced damage against players, from 20%.
Lightning Bolt and Overloaded Lightning Bolt now deals 0% reduced damage against players, from 7%.
Corruption now deals 20% reduced damage against players, from 30%.
Haunt healing animation will now always show.
Fixed a bug that allowed to equip two Fishing Poles with Titans Grip.

7.description: [Legacy] Fixed an issue where Master of Shadows in-game behaviour didn't match its tooltips. This change will will go live after the next server restart.

4.description: Implemented a system that allows to dynamically scale damage from abiltiies, healing and absorbs in different PvP scenarios.

6.description: Pending restart, Reduced the damage of 'Starving' on Moroes by 20%.
Pending restart, Wild Felstalker on Maulgar can now be banished properly.
Pending restart, Magtherion's Infernals can now be Slowed, Rooted in Place, Frozen in Place, Turn Evil Feared.
Pending restart, Magtheridon's Mind Exhaustion debuff will last 3 to 9 seconds on Flex.
Pending restart, High King Maulgar will no longer attack players when he uses his Charge ability.
[Seasonal] Reduced Physical Damage, Spell Damage, Health, and Healing of mobs in Magtheridon's Lair by 10%.
[Seasonal] Reduced Physical Damage, Spell Damage, Health, and Healing of mobs in Gruuls Lair by 10%.
[Seasonal] Reduced Physical Damage, Spell Damage, Health, and Healing of mobs in Karazhan by 10%.
Pending restart, Corrected an issue where Magtheridon's Mind Exhaustion debuff would last 90 seconds if you had more than 10 players, instead of gradually scaling to 90 seconds at 25 players.
Pending restart, Prince Malchezaar will now delay Adumbral Pool summoning by a static 6 seconds, up from 4-6 seconds.

7.description: Fixed an issue where Eviscerate wasn't properly triggering the Master of Shadows effect.

8.description: Adjusted requirements for [High-Risk] I am Become Death, Destroyer of Forges to not require Deathforge Key. Adjust quest text to no longer tell players how to acquire the key.

0.description: Pending restart, corrected an issue where you would be notified that your professions could be levelled up.
Pending restart, corrected an issue where you would be notified that your talents could be levelled up.
Aura of Experience now has an icon to match it's buff. It no longer looks like an EXP pot.

6.description: Introduced Doomwalker & Doom Lord Kazzak achievements.
Introduced Heroic Karazhan Realm First Completion Achievements.
In addition to Doom Lord Kazzak's normal loot template, he will now drop an extra 2 items from the loot table that are bloodforged in high-risk.
Reduced the effect of Nightmare Mode to 50% in raids, down from 300%.
Reduced the effect of Nightmare Mode to 100% in dungeons, down from 300%.

7.description: Prophet of Wrath is disabled until more client-side crashes are resolved with the Random Enchant. This random enchant is a free-reroll pending next restart.

0.description: Pending restart, you will now receive notifications when you are able to rank up your known abilities.

Added Alliance Hybrid Risk NPCs to Telaar, Sylvanaar, Area 52 and Wildhammer Stronghold
Added Alliance War Heralds to Telaar, Sylvanaar, Area 52, Wildhammer Stronghold that will offer 6 zone specific High Risk quests daily. Only one zone will have active quests each day.

6.description: Pending restart, Prince Malchezaar's Infernals no longer consider players in the Shadow Realm for the sake of targetting.

5.description: Ironweave Bag no longer has a level requirement.
